raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The Qwen3.8-27B cookbook page has no AMD recipe. AMD publishes an MXFP4 checkpoint for CDNA4, `amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4`: the language model is MXFP4 W4A4 and the vision encoder stays bf16. It runs on a single MI355X.

## Modifications

- `qwen3.8-27b.jsx`:
  - adds `mi355x` hardware and an `MXFP4` quantization option;
  - maps the model name to the AMD checkpoint;
  - sets the ROCm docker image (`lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.21-rocm724-mi35x-20261014`).
- New `mi355x` / `mxfp4` cell, single GPU like the other cells. Flags come from the AMD nightly performance config for this checkpoint at TP1:
  - `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `--quantization quark`, `--attention-backend aiter`;
  - `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3`, `--mem-fraction-static 0.9`, `--chunked-prefill-size 16384`;
  - the qwen3 reasoning and tool-call parsers.

  The cell reports **Final Verification In Progress** until the accuracy results below are in.
- The DSPARK overlay is disabled on MI355X: it pins a FlashInfer draft attention backend, which ROCm does not ship.
- Page text: MI355X added to the supported cards. A note recommends `--mm-enable-dp-encoder` when serving at `--tp-size 2`, so that each GPU encodes whole images instead of splitting every vision layer across both GPUs.

`node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs` passes.

## Accuracy Tests

Pending (MI355X): GSM8K (1319 questions, `run_eval`) for the new cell, and MMMU at TP2 with `--mm-enable-dp-encoder` off/on.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Pending (MI355X): image-serving throughput at TP2 with `--mm-enable-dp-encoder` off/on.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

   modelName: "Qwen3.8-27B",

       // to bf16 here rather than fp8_e4m3; the cells pin fp8_e4m3 explicitly,

       { id: "nvfp4-nvidia",    label: "NVFP4-NVIDIA"    },
+      // AMD's Quark export for CDNA4 (MI355X): MXFP4 W4A4 language model,
+      // vision encoder kept in bf16. OCP MXFP4, not NVFP4 -- only the
+      // mi355x cell serves it.
+      { id: "mxfp4",           label: "MXFP4"           },
     ] },
     { id: "nodes", title: "Nodes", options: [
       { id: "single", label: "Single Node" },
@@ -134,9 +138,15 @@ export const config = {
           // EAGLE. No --min-free-slots-delay: at --max-running-requests 1 it
           // is a strict no-op, and its real semantic (disable the delayer)
           // would silently bite anyone raising concurrency to 8+.
-          disabled: (sel) => sel.hw === "rtx5090" && !String(sel.quant).startsWith("nvfp4"),
-          disableReason:
-            "On the 32GB RTX 5090 the DSpark draft model only fits on top of the NVFP4 weights",
+          // Off on MI355X: the row pins a FlashInfer draft attention backend,
+          // which ROCm does not ship.
+          disabled: (sel) =>
+            sel.hw === "mi355x" ||

+          disableReason: (sel) =>
+            sel.hw === "mi355x"

+              : "On the 32GB RTX 5090 the DSpark draft model only fits on top of the NVFP4 weights",
           stripPrefixes: (sel) =>
             sel.hw === "rtx5090"
               ? ["--mem-fraction-static", "--mamba-full-memory-ratio",
@@ -329,6 +339,7 @@ export const config = {

     "default|nvfp4-fp4-head":  "RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4",
     "default|nvfp4-nvidia":    "nvidia/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4",

   },
 
   placeholders: {
@@ -377,6 +388,8 @@ export const config = {
     rtx5090: "lmsysorg/sglang:latest",
     "dgx-spark": "lmsysorg/sglang:latest",
     gb300:   "lmsysorg/sglang:latest",
+    // gfx950 build; the generic image is CUDA-only.
+    mi355x:  "lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.21-rocm724-mi35x-20261014",
   },
 
   github: {
@@ -1002,5 +1015,32 @@ export const config = {
         "--port {{PORT}}",
       ],
     },
+    {
+      // MI355X 288GB, AMD Quark MXFP4 (W4A4 language model, bf16 vision
+      // encoder). SGLANG_USE_AITER selects the AITER MXFP4 GEMM, attention,
+      // norm and rope kernels; the ROCm image sets it, a bare-pip host does
+      // not. The flags follow the AMD nightly performance config for this
+      // checkpoint at TP1. Accuracy on this card is still being run, so the
+      // whole envelope reports in-progress.
+      match: { hw: "mi355x", variant: "default", quant: "mxfp4", nodes: "single" },

+      verificationStatus: "in-progress",

+      ],
+      flags: [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--quantization quark",
+        "--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3",
+        "--mem-fraction-static 0.9",
+        "--attention-backend aiter",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size 16384",
+        "--reasoning-parser qwen3",
+        "--tool-call-parser qwen3_coder",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
   ],
